Package neqsim.mathlib.linearalgebra

Class RealBlockEigenDecomposition

java.lang.Object
neqsim.mathlib.linearalgebra.RealBlockEigenDecomposition
public final class RealBlockEigenDecomposition extends Object
Immutable real representation of an eigensystem, including complex conjugate pairs.

The columns of V form a real block basis, not individual real eigenvectors when imaginary parts are nonzero. In A V = V D, a conjugate pair a + i b, a - i b corresponds to the block [[a, b], [-b, a]] in D.

      public RealBlockEigenDecomposition(double[] realParts, double[] imaginaryParts, double[][] vectors)
      Copy paired eigenvalues and their real block basis in backend order.
      Parameters:
      realParts - real eigenvalue parts
      imaginaryParts - imaginary eigenvalue parts, with positive member first in each conjugate pair
      vectors - square real block basis V
